v.t: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

v.t: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

v.t: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

v.t: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

v.t: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
